import json,os; from pathlib import Path
group=next(line.split(':',2)[2] for line in Path('/proc/self/cgroup').read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith('0::'))
root=Path('/sys/fs/cgroup') / group.lstrip('/')
facts={k:(root/k).read_text().strip() for k in ('cpu.max','memory.max','memory.swap.max')}
facts['nice']=os.getpriority(os.PRIO_PROCESS,0)
print(json.dumps(facts))
quota,period=facts['cpu.max'].split()
assert quota!='max' and int(quota)==2*int(period)
assert facts['memory.max']==str(3*1024**3)
assert facts['memory.swap.max']=='0' and facts['nice']==10
